summary: East kerb runs right along house frontages, 4-9 m from dwellings.
reasons: Dwellings 4-9 m from kerb along most of it

drivers.seclusion: Detached homes at 4, 8 and 9 m behind hedges and fences along the whole east side.
drivers.access_and_room: Open sealed street, kerb parking possible, but only directly in front of houses.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street at a junction.
drivers.convention: Signed 2P Mon-Fri 7am-6pm, resident permits excepted; no camping seen.

sun_shade: Tree and hedge shade from the east side; open to the west.
